notes.title: Ethernal Playtest Future
notes.content:
[h1][i][b][u]UPDATE NOTES AT THE END OF THE POST[/u][/b][/i][/h1]

TLDR: Game completely redone from scratch, we hope you like it! Game dungeons coming next week, small gameplay test available right now.

Hi testers! It has been a while since we released an update for the playtest.

The first thing I want to tell you is that we are [b][u]NOT going to abandon the playtest[/u][/b]. We went under the radar for a long time, working hard on the feedback you gave to us to make a truly special game.

With the feedback we had and the stats Steam gave to us, we went on a working spree that has lasted for more than 6 months.

[b][u]We heard you.[/u][/b]

We have changed many things since then, and we are close to releasing the first stable Early Access version of the game. This does NOT mean we will just discard the playtest. There are [b]thousands[/b] of you with Ethernal in your library, sitting there in a dark spot.

We are proud to announce that [u][b]Ethernal Playtest will be pegged to Ethernal[/b][/u] and thus, receive the [u][b]same game updates[/b][/u] as regular players do [u][b]until the end of the current version[/b][/u], named [u][b]Carbon[/b][/u].

After this time, [b][u]things do NOT end there[/u][/b]!

When we move from Carbon to Ether, the next big update, we will terminate the playtest, but before doing it [b][u]we will giveaway copies of Ethernal on Steam[/u][/b], and [u][b]you[/b][/u], the testers, [u][b]will be informed of it before anyone else[/b][/u] knows so you can transition to the [u][b]playtest to the full game for free.[/b][/u]

[u][b]We will make a post[/b][/u] on the playtest community hub when the time comes, so make sure you [u][b]stay tuned[/b][/u] to the game updates and [u][b]don't miss out[/b][/u]! We want you guys to own the full game, because it would have been [u][b]impossible without you.[/b][/u]

[u][b]Thanks a lot! Updates will be coming![/b][/u]

- Ethernal team


[b][u]UPDATE NOTES[/u][/b]

This update is the start of a massive change in the game.

As of now, you can just play a small tutorial with a compact combat experience to get an idea of how things are evolving. 

We will upload the first dungeons once we have them (in the next week!), but for now we leave you with this distilled experience on the game mechanics. It will take you no more than 10 minutes to play, even less!
